name: Influence
base_effect: Influence the emotions of one engaged target. Can inflict 1 strain to add success/failure to social check.
narrative_capability: Can subtly influence the emotions of nearby beings — calming hostility, heightening fear, or implanting a single suggestion in a weak-willed mind.
gm_choice_guidance: Offer mind-affecting choices when the character could persuade, deceive, or calm someone through the Force rather than words alone. Influence replaces Charm/Coercion/Deception tags with Force:Influence. Mind tricks presented as social choices with Force tag. Do not offer against strong-willed targets unless the character has Strength upgrades.
dark_side_flavor: Dark side Influence doesn't suggest — it overrides. The target's will bends not because they're persuaded but because something stronger than their own mind is pressing down on them. Their eyes go slightly unfocused. They agree too quickly.

control_mind_trick.name: Control: Mind Trick
control_mind_trick.effect: Implant a single short command in the target's mind. Opposed by Discipline.
control_mind_trick.narrative: The gap between suggesting and commanding narrows to nothing. A thought placed precisely enough becomes the target's own.

range_1.name: Range
range_1.effect: Increase range of Influence by one range band.
range_1.narrative: Distance is no longer a shield. The character's will reaches further than their voice.

strength_1.name: Strength: Deeper Influence
strength_1.effect: Mind trick commands can be more complex. Longer-lasting emotional manipulation.
strength_1.narrative: The crude tool refines. What was a blunt push becomes a precise adjustment — the target's motivations rearranged, their priorities gently rewritten.

magnitude_1.name: Magnitude
magnitude_1.narrative: One mind, then two. The Force doesn't distinguish between them — what it can do to one, it can do to many.
